text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One evening...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I come across Mejiro McQueen studying in 
the cafeteria late at night.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
So if I were to substitute this formula 
here... That makes sense.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! Yes, there's a short quiz 
tomorrow. I thought that I would 
conduct a 
quick review.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I was having a few difficulties, however, 
which is why I'm still here.
choice_data_list: Want to ease up on tomorrow's training?
Go easy on training tomorrow, then?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, there's no need to do that. As a 
Mejiro, I am accustomed to 
balancing both 
mental and physical discipline.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I expect the standard regimen 
at practice tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As requested, we conduct our training 
regimen as usual the next day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No doubt due to how late she was up 
studying last night, McQueen 
begins to 
nod off during our post-training meeting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Eek!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
O-of course I am! A Mejiro brings nothing 
but her full attention to 
every interaction!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
We were reviewing all of today's training 
exercises, yes?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Given her condition, I decide it would be 
best to start things over one 
more time. 
But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
choice_data_list: Did you not sleep after all...?
Did you not sleep after all...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-I really wasn't sleeping, dozing, or even 
dreaming! It must be your 
imagination.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Please continue. I'm all ears.
choice_data_list: Let's end it here for today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But we were in the middle of a 
meeting...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh... but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It looks like I've exhibited cause for 
concern once again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to cause you any more undue 
trouble, so let's wrap it up 
for today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Thank you as always, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Make sure you sleep at night.
Make sure you sleep at night.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'll have you know that I am managing my 
sleep schedule perfectly 
fine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: AND I was actually paying proper attention back there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I must ask that you believe me! I insist!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems much work remains to be done to 
persuade the prideful 
McQueen to 
acknowledge her limits.
